events.description: India Quiz: Test your knowledge of India’s history, culture, geography, heritage, and current affairs.
rules: Open to all branches.
Cross-year teams are allowed.
Participants may compete solo or in a team of up to 3 people.
The quiz has two parts: Qualifiers and Finals.
The top 8 teams qualify for the Finals.
